target_user.description: Self-attestation that the participant matches the intended Godot/game-creator audience.

implementation_involvement.description: Self-attestation that the participant had no implementation, review, or maintenance involvement; identifying details are not collected.

eligibility_verified_by_observer.description: The facilitator independently confirmed target-user eligibility without copying identifying details into this report.

role_profile.description: De-identified audience role/experience only; do not include names, contact details, accounts, or project paths.

understand_flow.description: Can explain what the reward flow does and whether the explanation matches its actual behavior.

judge_naturalness.description: Can judge whether labels, cards, and branching read naturally and clearly.

edit_and_preview.description: Can edit the animation duration, understand the preview, and confirm the intended change.

run_correctly.description: The observed run produces the expected score, animation, replacement row, and result notice.

operation_confidence.description: Reports whether the flow feels understandable and manageable without source-code or startup instructions.

items.description: Short de-identified paraphrase, never a raw transcript.

summary.description: De-identified observation summary; no raw transcript or identity.
De-identified blocker summary; do not include raw participant content or identity.
